ownSubjectReview.geometry: Approximate centers O=(322,502), A=(449,351), B=(879,218). The three arrows share these endpoints, so OA+AB=OB geometrically. AB shaft slope about -0.309 and upper-right r about -0.307 agree at rendered stroke scale. No xyz axes remain; the heading explicitly says Richtungsskizze.
ownSubjectReview.meaning: Position is anchored at O, displacement connects A to B, direction identifies a parallel line direction. The corrected card explicitly rejects a finite line-length interpretation.
counterchecks: g(t)=A+t(3,1,2) gives A at t=0, B at t=1 and (7,4,5) at t=2; the line continues beyond B.
A nonzero scalar multiple of r parameterizes the same line; |r|=sqrt(14) is a vector length, not the length of that infinite line.
The zero vector cannot serve as a line direction.
ownSubjectReview.limits: Axis-free direction sketch illustrates roles and vector relations, not component reading from a calibrated 3D projection. It is supporting illustration, not a replacement for the full unchanged competency.
